notes.title: Basingstoke
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953219/ce07f84869228010614efe047e42b3371d25c91a.png[/img]

[h1]Basingstoke Is Nearly Here[/h1]

Minions! Let is be known that our vicious roguelike survival horror game [b]BASINGSTOKE[/b] is due for release on [b]Mar 30, 2018 @ 11:00am PST[/b]. Go forth and [url=store.steampowered.com/app/336940/Basingstoke]wishlist it[/url] so you'll get a reminder when it finally appears (with a wee discount).

[h1]Eh? What's Basingstoke?[/h1]

We've spent the last [b]four years[/b] making a game about escaping a mediocre small town in southern England. Set in the near future, Basingstoke has been invaded by the evil Titans, and nearly everyone has been killed by a neutron bomb. [i]Nearly[/i] everyone...

You've got to escape alive through Basingstoke's randomly generated suburban sprawl, looting bodies as you go, crafting new things to help you evade detection, distract your enemies, or just plain old kill them as a last resort. Everything you encounter will kill you instantly, so stealth and planning are the keys to survival. And running away a lot while throwing sausage rolls over your shoulder.

A few more details can be found [url=http://www.puppygames.net/basingstoke]here[/url] on our site.

notes.title: Titan Attacks for Android
notes.content:
So, we finally made Titan Attacks for Android a thing.

It is [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.puppygames.titanattacks]here[/url]. And it is [b]free[/b], if you can stand ads, so there's no excuse not to have it on your phone!*

If you can't stand ads you can give Google a couple of bucks to make them go away, but only weirdos do that.


* Unless you are one of those strange [i]Apple types[/i], in which case, you will have to wait a few more days before we get the iOS one out...
